shelf.label: Panopin shelf
shelf.hints: Preview Space · Copy Enter · Paste Ctrl+Enter · Pin P · Take down S · Library L · Close Esc
shelf.hints.mac: Preview Space · Copy Enter · Paste ⌘Enter · Pin P · Take down S · Library L · Close Esc
shelf.empty.title: The board is empty
shelf.empty.body: Things you copy and screenshots you take get taped here. Pin the ones you want to keep.
shelf.search.label: Search the shelf
shelf.ocr.none: No text was found in this image.
shelf.ocr.unavailable: Reading text needs an OCR language in Windows (Settings → Privacy).
shelf.link.previewsOff: Link previews are off. Turn them on in Settings → Privacy.
shelf.paste.gone: The window you came from has closed, so nothing was pasted.
shelf.paste.elevated: That app runs as administrator, so Windows does not let Panopin paste into it. The item is on the clipboard: press Ctrl+V there.
shelf.paste.password: That is a password field, so nothing was pasted.
shelf.paste.failed: Pasting did not work. The item is on the clipboard: press Ctrl+V.
shelf.paste.failed.mac: Pasting did not work. The item is on the clipboard: press ⌘V.
shelf.paste.permission: Panopin needs Accessibility permission to paste: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility. The item is on the clipboard: press ⌘V.

preview.autosave.mac: Saved as you type · Esc or ⌘Enter to finish
preview.editHint: E or a click to edit
preview.loadFailed: This item could not be opened.

settings.title: Panopin Settings
settings.language.review: This translation was made by machine and is waiting for a native speaker's review. Corrections are welcome on GitHub.
settings.edgeOpen: Open by resting the pointer on the edge
settings.edgeOpenHelp: Rest the pointer on that screen edge for a moment. Not while a game, video or presentation fills the screen.
settings.shortcut.listening: Press the new keys. Esc cancels, Backspace turns it off.
settings.shortcut.taken: Another app uses these keys, so this shortcut does not work.
settings.shortcut.altGr: Saved. Ctrl+Alt is what AltGr sends, so this shortcut can block a character you type with AltGr.
settings.shortcut.help: A global shortcut needs Win, Ctrl or Alt. While you record, Panopin's own shortcuts pause.
settings.shortcut.help.mac: A global shortcut needs ⌘, ⌃ or ⌥. While you record, Panopin's own shortcuts pause.
settings.material: Mica behind the Library and Settings
settings.material.mac: A translucent background behind the Library and Settings
settings.animationsHelp: On, they follow Windows' animation effects; off, nothing moves.
settings.animationsHelp.mac: On, they follow Reduce motion in the macOS accessibility settings; off, nothing moves.
settings.source.screenshotsHint: The Windows Screenshots folder and the folders below. The files are only read.
settings.source.screenshotsHint.mac: The folder macOS saves screenshots to (the Desktop unless another is chosen in the Screenshot app) and the folders below. The files are only read.
settings.source.clipboardTextHint: Everything you copy as text is saved on this PC until it expires.
settings.source.clipboardTextHint.mac: Everything you copy as text is saved on this Mac until it expires.
settings.source.screenRecordingsHint: Videos\Screen Recordings and the folders below. Off by default.
settings.source.screenRecordingsHint.mac: MP4 files in the folders below. macOS saves its own recordings as .mov, which Panopin does not keep yet. Off by default.
settings.sources.foldersHelp: Up to three. Pictures in them count as screenshots, MP4 files as recordings.
settings.history.keepHelp: Pinned, named, filed and tagged items never expire. The rest go to Trash when their time is up.
settings.history.clearHelp: Moves unsaved items to Trash. Saved items stay.
settings.privacy.excludedHelp: Copies made in these apps are not saved. Copies that Windows or password managers mark as private never are.
settings.privacy.excludedHelp.mac: Copies made in these apps are not saved. Copies that password managers mark as private never are.
settings.privacy.linkPreviewsHelp: Panopin visits each copied https link once for its title and picture. Local addresses and links with passwords or tokens are never visited.
settings.privacy.ocrHelp: Windows reads images on this PC, in the background, so their text can be searched and copied.
settings.privacy.ocrHelp.mac: macOS reads images on this Mac, in the background, so their text can be searched and copied.
settings.privacy.ocrUnsupported: Not available on this system yet.
settings.privacy.ocrAddLanguage: No Turkish or English OCR language is installed. Add one in Windows Settings → Time & language → Language & region, with its optical character recognition feature.
settings.updates.autoHelp: At start and every 6 hours, from GitHub. Nothing is installed until you choose to.
settings.about.thirdPartyHelp: Panopin is built with these open-source packages.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Panopin
onboarding.intro: Panopin quietly keeps what you copy and the screenshots you take, and slides them in on a cork board when you need them.
onboarding.source.screenshots.mac: Screenshots (⇧⌘3, ⇧⌘4 and the folder they are saved to)
onboarding.textNote: Text is collected too: everything you copy as text is saved on this PC until it expires.
onboarding.textNote.mac: Text is collected too: everything you copy as text is saved on this Mac until it expires.
onboarding.privacy: Everything stays on this PC and nothing is sent anywhere. Copies from password managers and content Windows marks as private are never saved.
onboarding.privacy.mac: Everything stays on this Mac and nothing is sent anywhere. Copies that password managers mark as private are never saved.
onboarding.notVault: Panopin is not a password vault: saved items are not encrypted.
onboarding.linkPreviewsHelp: To show a page's title and picture, Panopin connects to that site. Off unless you turn it on.

settings.updates.installHelp: Panopin closes, installs the new version and starts again. Your items and settings stay.
settings.updates.portable: This copy is portable, so it does not replace itself: download the new version and unzip it over this one.
settings.updates.failed: Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
settings.updates.installFailed: The update could not be installed. Try again, or download it from GitHub.
